Definition: from G514; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.
BiblicalUsage: To count worthy is to judge someone fit for what is asked of them. The centurion did not think himself worthy for Jesus to come under his roof; the Jews at Rome wanted to hear Paul because they knew his sect was spoken against everywhere; Hebrews says Christ was counted worthy of more glory than Moses; and Paul prays God would count the Thessalonians worthy of their calling.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe worthiness is something God counts, not something I earn. Christ was counted worthy of glory, and because of him, God counts me worthy of the calling he gave me.
